{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    private const string TestSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        A,\n        B,\n        C\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public MyEnum Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_IncludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNet80()\n    {\n        bool hasAttribute = await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeAsync();\n        Assert.True(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_ExcludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNetStandard20()\n    {\n        bool hasAttribute = await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeAsync(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\");\n        Assert.False(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_ExcludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNetFramework()\n    {\n        bool hasAttribute = await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeAsync(\"NETFRAMEWORK\");\n        Assert.False(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<bool> HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeAsync(params string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> msgPackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkRefs.Concat(msgPackRefs).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(TestSource, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? enumSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.MyEnum\");\n        Assert.NotNull(enumSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol targetInterface = formatterInterface.Construct(enumSymbol);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> enumFormatters = GetAllTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace)\n            .Where(t => t.TypeKind == TypeKind.Class && t.AllInterfaces.Contains(targetInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default))\n            .ToList();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol enumFormatter = Assert.Single(enumFormatters);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        return enumFormatter.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol root)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in root.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in root.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol deeper in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return deeper;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
